Any charges mentioned in specific currencies are solely considered as examples, and do not take currency fluctuations or discrepancies into account. You are responsible for monitoring your Viber Out usage. You can check your current credit balance and consumption history at any time within the Viber App settings or your account portal.</p>
<p>The rates for calling landlines and mobile phones outside of the Viber community consist of a per-minute rate as set out on <strong><span style="color: #5f44d2;"><a style="color: #5f44d2;" href="https://account.viber.com/en/rates-index">https://account.viber.com/en/rates-index</a></span></strong> and within the Viber App and your Account. After a 4-hour call duration, the call will be disconnected and require a re-dial. While we always try to keep our rates as low as possible, Viber may change the rates for calling phones at any time without notice to you by posting such change at <strong><span style="color: #5f44d2;"><a style="color: #5f44d2;" href="http://account.viber.com/">http://account.viber.com/</a></span></strong>. The new rate will apply to your next phone call after the new rates have been published. Please check the latest rates before you make your call. If you do not accept the new rates, do not make your call.</p>
<p>The duration of a call is calculated per seconds and shall be based on one-minute increments. Fractions of minutes will be rounded up to the next minute. At the end of a call, fractional cent charges will be rounded up or down to the nearest whole cent. For example, a total call at a price of €0.034 will be rounded to €0.03. During the call, charges incurred will be deducted automatically from the Viber Credit balance in your Account.</p>
<p>If you do not use your Viber Credit for a period of six months (including Viber Credit that has been allocated to you by a Viber administrator), such credit will be frozen. You can reactivate the Viber Credit by accessing your Viber Out account and following the instructions therein. If your Account is deactivated, your Viber Credit will be lost. For this purpose, your Account may be deactivated in any of the following way: (i) you actively deactivate your Account; (ii) you remove Viber from your mobile device and do not reinstall it within three months; (iii) you do not log in to Viber for twelve consecutive months.</p>
<p>If you use third party services to purchase Viber Credit, such purchase is also subject to the terms of such third party (including with respect to payment terms, refunds, etc.).</p>
<p>For users in Japan, and users with Japanese area code (+81), that purchase Viber Credit, the Viber Credit will expire within 180 days of purchase, with no ability to reactivate.</p>
<h6><span style="color: #5f44d2;"><strong>Emergency Calls</strong></span></h6>
<p>To allow safe access to emergency services, the Viber mobile app initiates emergency calls through sending any 3 digit call, such as the European emergency number 112, to your mobile device’s native dial pad and your mobile network operator which in turn is set to direct the call free of charge and to the most appropriate Public Safety Answering Points.<strong> </strong></p>
<h6><span style="color: #5f44d2;"><strong>Technical Support</strong></span></h6>
<p>In case you experience any issue with the Viber Out service, please contact our support as provided under section 21 of the Terms and our team will check such report and will endeavor to remedy any such fault as reasonably feasible. For any information relating to technical details with respect to the calls transferred between mobile networks, please review your agreement with your mobile operator.</p>
<h4></h4>
<h4 style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: #5f44d2;"><strong>Viber eSIM Service Specific Terms</strong></span></h4>
<p><a id="viber-esim"></a>These Viber eSIM Service Specific Terms govern your access to and use of Viber’s eSIM Services, in addition to the Viber Terms of Service. <p><span style="font-weight: normal !msorm;"><strong>eSIM Services</strong></span></p>
<p>Viber’s eSIM Services provide data-only mobile connectivity through an embedded SIM (“eSIM”). The eSIM Services are offered on a prepaid, one-time purchase basis, and are made available through specific data plans or packages, which may vary by country or region, as determined by Viber. The eSIM Services are only available on devices that are compatible with eSIMs, and it is your responsibility to ensure that your device supports the eSIM Services. Any list of compatible devices provided by Viber is for illustrative purposes only and does not guarantee compatibility. You remain responsible for verifying that your device is supported.</p>
<p><span style="font-weight: normal !msorm;"><strong>Activation, Installation and Usage</strong></span></p>
<p>Upon purchase, the eSIM will be delivered digitally. Viber will provide you with the necessary activation information such as a QR code, activation link, or activation details which you can manually enter on your device, or other similar means. Viber may modify these activation methods at any time without prior notice.</p>
<p>Purchasing the eSIM does not automatically start the service. The eSIM is a digital service consumed on your device outside of the Viber App, hence you must download or activate the eSIM on your device in order to start using the eSIM Services. A stable internet connection is required for the download and activation of the eSIM.</p>
<p>The eSIM Services can only be used in the intended destination country or region. Once downloaded, the eSIM remains on your device even after your data plan has been fully consumed or has expired. You may remove the eSIM from your device at any time via your device settings, however we recommend that you do not remove it until your data plan has been consumed or expired. No refund will be provided for unused services.</p>
<p>The amount of data, activation period and the validity period of the eSIM Services will be specified to you at the time of purchase. The eSIM Services are available only until the data plan expires or the purchased volume is fully consumed, whichever comes first. Any remaining data after expiration will be lost, and no extensions, refunds, or credits will be provided for unused data or time remaining on expired plans. You are responsible for monitoring your data plan validity period and usage. The eSIM Services may also be subject to usage limits, fair usage policies, or other restrictions as communicated by Viber.</p>
<p>Viber reserves the right to monitor your use of the eSIM Services and to regulate, limit, suspend or terminate usage that disrupts, interferes or negatively impacts the eSIM Services, the performance of the network, or the service quality or experience of other users. In the event of suspension or termination due to violation of these Terms, the Fair Usage Policy, or any applicable Viber policies, any remaining data, credits, or unused services associated with your eSIM will be forfeited without refund, and Viber shall have no obligation to provide compensation of any kind.</p>
<p><span style="font-weight: normal !msorm;"><strong>Availability and Restrictions</strong></span></p>
<p>The eSIM Services are intended for use in supported countries or regions only. Availability of the eSIM Services may vary by country or region. Viber may, at any time and subject to applicable law, update, restrict, limit or discontinue the service in certain locations, including by adding or removing supported countries or regions, without prior notice to you.</p>
<p>Viber reserves the right to change the terms, pricing, available data plans or packages, features and functionalities for the eSIM Services or otherwise terminate the service at any time and at our sole discretion. This includes the right to provide distinct offers or features in each plan, add new features, or change or cancel any existing features. However, any such changes will apply only to future purchases and will not affect eSIM Services or data plans already purchased. Other changes to the eSIM Services may take effect immediately where such changes are exclusively to your benefit, are of a purely administrative nature and have no negative effect on you, or are directly required by applicable law.</p>
<p>Viber may also suspend or terminate the eSIM services when we are obliged to comply with an order, request or instruction of any government or regulatory authority, or with applicable laws or regulations.</p>
<p>The eSIM Services are provided through our third-party telecommunications partners or technology providers, which vary from jurisdiction to jurisdiction. Data connectivity, network coverage, availability and performance depend solely on these partners, and Viber has no control over these. By using the eSIM Services, you also agree to comply with relevant terms and policies of our partners and you acknowledge that we may disclose and use your personal data to provide the services subject to our <a href="https://www.viber.com/en/terms/viber-privacy-policy/">Privacy Policy</a>. Viber reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to choose or change partners for the eSIM Services as it deems appropriate, or to provide the service directly where permitted, at any time and without prior notice to you.</p>
<p><span style="font-weight: normal !msorm;"><strong>User Responsibilities</strong></span></p>
<p>When purchasing or using the eSIM Services, you are responsible for: (i) using the Service in compliance with these Terms, any other applicable Viber terms or policies, and all relevant network operator or partner policies; (ii) complying with all applicable laws and regulations, including  in any jurisdiction in which you are a citizen, resident, or present while using the Service; (iii) all use of the Service, including any content, information and communications, associated with your account, device, or eSIM, whether by you or a third party; (iv) ensuring your device is compatible with the Service and properly configured; (v) submit true, accurate or complete documents or information as may be requested by Viber, such as but not limited to, proof of identity or for regulatory compliance; (vi) monitoring your data consumption in accordance with your purchased or allocated package; (vii) complying with all reasonable security procedures and standards with respect to the eSIM Services, which Viber may communicate to you from time to time; and (viii) maintaining the security of your device and eSIM, including protection against loss, theft, or unauthorized use. Failure to meet these responsibilities may result in suspension or termination of the eSIM Services without notice.</p>

  <div class="container security-intro">
    <div class="row align-items-center justify-content-around pb-5">
      <div class="col-md-5 order-1 order-md-0">
        <h1>Private and secure messaging</h1>
        <p>All around the world, users turn to Viber to have open and authentic conversations with their friends, family and colleagues. With Viber you can rest assured, knowing that your personal chats are always protected and private and that all your conversations are your own. Our mission is to protect that privacy so you never have to think twice about what you can or can’t share when you’re using Viber.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="video-wrap order-0 order-md-1 offset-md-1 col-md-6">
        <div class="video-inner">
          <video id="featured-video" width="390" height="390" preload="yes" autoplay playsinline loop muted
                 poster="https://www.viber.com/app/themes/viber/assets/images/secure-poster.jpg">
            <source src="https://www.viber.com/app/themes/viber/assets/video/security-video.mp4"
                    type='video/mp4'/>
            <source src="https://www.viber.com/app/themes/viber/assets/video/security-video.webm"
                    type='video/webm'/>
            <source src="https://www.viber.com/app/themes/viber/assets/video/security-video.ogv"
                    type='video/ogv'/>

            Your browser does not support the video tag.
          </video>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="reasons">

    <div class="container-fluid">
      <div class="row justify-content-center">
        <div class="col-md-11">
          <div class="row justify-content-center">
            
                <div class="col-md-12 col-lg-3 ml-4 mr-4 reason">
                  <h3 class="bold">We don’t read or listen to any of your chats and calls</h3>
                  <p>Unlike some other messaging apps, Viber can’t read your personal chats (one-on-one chats and group chats) or listen in on your one-on-one audio or video calls. We use end-to-end encryption by default, so no need to go out of your way to turn it on. Your private and group communications are completely safe so that only you and the people you’re talking to can read or hear them.</p>
                </div>

              
                <div class="col-md-12 col-lg-3 ml-4 mr-4 reason">
                  <h3 class="bold">We can’t and don’t sell what you share</h3>
                  <p>When your chats are protected by end-to-end encryption, no one can access them. Perhaps most importantly, Viber doesn’t have access to them—which means nothing you share can be used by Viber or 3rd parties to target you with ads later. Some other messaging apps don’t offer end-to-end encryption by default—hence they can access, read, and sell your private conversations to others for advertising purposes.</p>
                </div>

              
                <div class="col-md-12 col-lg-3 ml-4 mr-4 reason">
                  <h3 class="bold">More than encryption</h3>
                  <p>Not only are your communications protected by end-to-end encryption by default, but nothing you share is ever stored on Viber’s servers once delivered. Messages you send make their way from your device to the recipient as an encrypted code. If the recipient’s phone is off or they don’t have an internet connection—your message will wait patiently on Viber’s servers for a limited time only—still safe and encrypted—until their device is set to receive and decrypt it.</p>
                </div>

                        </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="features">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="title">
        <h2>100% privacy you can trust</h2>
        <p>6 ways to ensure your message, chats, and calls are completely private and also empower you with more privacy when you want it.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/end-to-end-encryption.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">End-to-end encryption by default</h3>
              <p>Messages you send make their way from your device to the recipient’s in the form of an encrypted code that only their device can translate to plain text using an encryption key.</p>
<p>Encryption keys exist only on user devices and nowhere else. So no one—not even Viber—can read your messages.</p>
            </div>
                      <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/Disappearing-Messages-1.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">Disappearing Messages</h3>
              <p>Set a self-destruct timer for every message in your chat so that after your message is read, it is automatically deleted from the Viber chat— all sides of the conversation.</p>
<p>While its ON, screenshot actions will be notified in the chat. Privacy is privacy 😉</p>
            </div>
                      <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/editDelete-1.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">Edit & Delete Messages for All</h3>
              <p>Sending a message with a typo can be annoying, but don’t stress—just long tap the message and quickly fix it.</p>
<p>If you still want to, delete the sent message on all sides of the conversation, even if it was already seen. You control what you share.</p>
            </div>
                      <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/Hidden-Number-Chats.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">Hidden-Number Chats</h3>
              <p>When you meet new people in a community or find them by name search on Viber— start a safer chat directly, without the need to exchange or expose yours or their phone numbers.</p>
            </div>
                      <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/Hide-Chats.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">Hide Chats</h3>
              <p>Planning a surprise party and don’t want anyone to accidentally see your conversation? Hide chats from your chat list and access them whenever you need to with a PIN.</p>
            </div>
                      <div class="col-md-4">
              <img src="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/under-the-radar-1.png" alt="">
              <h3 class="bold">Under the radar</h3>
              <p>Control when others can see your online status and the delivery status of the messages they send you.</p>
            </div>
                </div>
      <div class="support">
        <p>Learn more about Viber’s security measures on our <a href="https://vb.me/ProtectPrivacy" target="_blank" rel="noopener">support site</a>.<br />
Viber’s security protocol was based on the “double ratchet” protocol found in Open Whisper Systems Signal application, with our own proprietary implementation and additions. Our entire security overview is available <a href="https://www.viber.com/app/uploads/viber-encryption-overview.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

Home Download Features Communities Security Viber Out Blog Business Home Download Features Communities Security Viber Out Blog Business Business Private and secure messaging All around the world, users turn to Viber to have open and authentic conversations with their friends, family and colleagues. With Viber you can rest assured, knowing that your personal chats are always protected and private and that all your conversations are your own. Our mission is to protect that privacy so you never have to think twice about what you can or can’t share when you’re using Viber. Your browser does not support the video tag. We don’t read or listen to any of your chats and calls Unlike some other messaging apps, Viber can’t read your personal chats (one-on-one chats and group chats) or listen in on your one-on-one audio or video calls. We use end-to-end encryption by default, so no need to go out of your way to turn it on. Your private and group communications are completely safe so that only you and the people you’re talking to can read or hear them. We can’t and don’t sell what you share When your chats are protected by end-to-end encryption, no one can access them. Perhaps most importantly, Viber doesn’t have access to them—which means nothing you share can be used by Viber or 3rd parties to target you with ads later. Some other messaging apps don’t offer end-to-end encryption by default—hence they can access, read, and sell your private conversations to others for advertising purposes. More than encryption Not only are your communications protected by end-to-end encryption by default, but nothing you share is ever stored on Viber’s servers once delivered. Messages you send make their way from your device to the recipient as an encrypted code. If the recipient’s phone is off or they don’t have an internet connection—your message will wait patiently on Viber’s servers for a limited time only—still safe and encrypted—until their device is set to receive and decrypt it. 100% privacy you can trust 6 ways to ensure your message, chats, and calls are completely private and also empower you with more privacy when you want it. End-to-end encryption by default Messages you send make their way from your device to the recipient’s in the form of an encrypted code that only their device can translate to plain text using an encryption key. Encryption keys exist only on user devices and nowhere else. So no one—not even Viber—can read your messages. Disappearing Messages Set a self-destruct timer for every message in your chat so that after your message is read, it is automatically deleted from the Viber chat— all sides of the conversation. While its ON, screenshot actions will be notified in the chat. Privacy is privacy 😉 Edit & Delete Messages for All Sending a message with a typo can be annoying, but don’t stress—just long tap the message and quickly fix it. If you still want to, delete the sent message on all sides of the conversation, even if it was already seen. You control what you share. Hidden-Number Chats When you meet new people in a community or find them by name search on Viber— start a safer chat directly, without the need to exchange or expose yours or their phone numbers. Hide Chats Planning a surprise party and don’t want anyone to accidentally see your conversation? Hide chats from your chat list and access them whenever you need to with a PIN. Under the radar Control when others can see your online status and the delivery status of the messages they send you. Learn more about Viber’s security measures on our support site . Viber’s security protocol was based on the “double ratchet” protocol found in Open Whisper Systems Signal application, with our own proprietary implementation and additions. Our entire security overview is available here .
